description: Draft-agnostic structural and semantic schema notes for the Modly extension dependency/model/platform evidence library.

local_assets_contract.rule: Optional entry.local_assets records path-safe logical identifiers below extensions/ and models/ only when evidence supports the mapping.

entry_fields.extension_id: Primary logical extension folder and manifest identity candidate, e.g. extensions/trellis-2.
entry_fields.manifest_ids: Ordered additional manifest id candidates, if evidenced.
entry_fields.aliases: Ordered alternate logical extension folder ids; these are candidates, not compatibility claims.
entry_fields.model_roots: Optional logical roots below models/ used with model_assets; never host paths.
entry_fields.model_assets: Weight-specific model location candidates with weight_id, roots, subpaths, sentinel_files, status, confidence, and evidence_ids.
entry_fields.unknowns: Human-readable deferred evidence gaps; must not contain candidate strings for unsupported variants.

local_assets_contract.path_safety: No host-local absolute paths, file:// URLs, http URLs, drive-letter paths, traversal, empty segments, slash-bearing segment fields, hidden backup prefixes, or unsafe characters. Subpaths and sentinel_files are relative logical paths whose every segment passes the safe-segment rules.
local_assets_contract.presence_semantics: Local presence is evidence-only and not runtime compatibility, auth success, model completeness, installation success, or generation success.
local_assets_contract.precedence: Local_assets extension ids, aliases, manifest ids, and model_assets are checked before manifest/repository basename fallbacks.
local_assets_contract.duplicate_alias_rule: Shared aliases require manifest/repo correspondence before a present result; absent or conflicting correspondence remains unknown or invalid.

upstream_requirements_contract.rule: Optional entry.upstream_requirements records evidence-backed upstream install/setup expectations and exact-stack lanes without claiming Modly runtime enforcement.
upstream_requirements_contract.notes: Use dependency_sources URLs and explicit unknowns instead of inventing evidence ids or pretending the stack is runtime-enforced.

torch_lane_contract.rule: Do not infer CUDA, CPU, ROCm, or MPS support. Use accelerator_lanes and package index or unknown_reason explicitly.

no_dependencies_reason_contract.rule: Allowed only for non-ML or registry-only entries with no dependency_groups and no model_weights. It is mutually exclusive with dependency/model records and must carry evidence_ids.

claim_contract.claim: Human-readable exact claim string. Claim-bearing install, runtime, model, platform, and risk objects reference evidence_ids.
claim_contract.evidence_ids: Evidence record ids whose claim value exactly matches the claim object for non-unknown confidence claims.

github_identity_contract.rule: For GitHub-backed entries, identity.repo must be the canonical public owner/repo and identity.public_url must equal https://github.com/${identity.repo} exactly. Do not infer repositories from labels, display names, local folders, or ComfyUI naming patterns.

github_evidence_consistency_contract.rule: GitHub evidence source values must resolve to the same owner/repo as identity.repo unless a narrow documented entry/evidence exception is added and reviewed.

sanitization_rules: No inaccessible project identifiers that imply public availability.
